entries.title: Basic training + homeland defence
entries.text: Ten-week homeland defence special training. Rank: Obergefreiter. Structure, resilience, leading under pressure — not as a buzzword, as daily routine.

entries.title: Key Account Management Chemicals & Automotive
entries.text: Managing strategic accounts in chemical logistics and dangerous goods. Where I watched real humans spend hours on copy-paste — and started changing it.

entries.title: B.A. Business Administration — Shipping, Transport & Logistics
entries.text: Dual degree, final grade 2.1. Thesis graded 1.4: “Opportunities and Risks of Automating Spot-Market Sales through Artificial Intelligence — Conception of a Dialogue-Based Quote Creation”.

entries.title: Leading MyBriem — digitisation platform
entries.text: Company-wide platform owned end-to-end: React, SQL Server, GitHub. Five core processes digitised, teams trained, platform carried into production.

entries.title: BizOps Analyst
entries.text: Process analysis, business cases, LLM and API integrations — one goal: turn manual effort into measurable output. Next step: M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence for Business Management.

cases.title: LLM-assisted quote system
cases.text: Conception and validation of a dialogue-based system for spot-market quote creation. Built on primary research in sales, human-in-the-loop by design: the machine drafts, the human decides.

cases.title: Freight invoice audit web app
cases.text: From requirements to rollout: a web app that audits freight invoices. OCR parsing, plausibility checks, deviations become visible instead of expensive. Built, trained, used daily.

cases.title: Real-time shipment tracking
cases.text: Proof of concept for premium automotive customers: GPS feeds pulled in automatically via SFTP, shipments traceable live. From raw feed to customer-facing view — no manual steps in between.
